Status Draft
Description

此 Library 為乳癌早期乳癌）患者於申請使用 Trastuzumab Emtansine 之給付檢核條件。

Resource: https://nhicore.nhi.gov.tw/cql/Library/BCReusable|1.0.0

//早期乳癌_Trastuzumab Emtansine給付規定
library BCTrastuzumabEmtansineRule1 version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

include BCCodeConcept version '1.0.0' called CodeConcept

include BCReusable version '1.0.0' called Reusable

context Patient


//============================================
// 主要規定一：初次使用條件
//============================================

/*規則1*/

//1規則1:使用於具HER2過度表現(IHC 3+或FISH+)之早期乳癌病人
define "1規則1=檢驗檢查-HER2過度表現(IHC3+或FISH+)":
  Reusable."HasHER2OverexpressionTest"

define "1規則1=基因檢測-HER2過度表現(IHC3+或FISH+)":
  Reusable."HasHER2OverexpressionGene"

define "檢查報告-1規則1=使用於具HER2過度表現(IHC 3+或FISH+)之早期乳癌病人":
  Reusable."HasDiagnosticReportResult"(CodeConcept.HER2, '(?i).*(IHC3\\+|FISH\\+).*')

define "1規則1=使用於具HER2過度表現(IHC 3+或FISH+)之早期乳癌病人":
  "1規則1=檢驗檢查-HER2過度表現(IHC3+或FISH+)"
  or "1規則1=基因檢測-HER2過度表現(IHC3+或FISH+)"
  or "檢查報告-1規則1=使用於具HER2過度表現(IHC 3+或FISH+)之早期乳癌病人"


//1規則2:曾接受過至少6個療程（每3週一療程，至少16週）的化學治療（其中至少3個療程(9週)的taxane藥物）
//1規則2-1:每三周療程之非taxane化學治療，合併計算各種化療藥物之療程，至少3個療程且總療程天數至少49天
// 同一起始日視為同一療程；若同一療程內有多筆非taxane藥物，只保留結束日最晚的那筆代表該療程
define "1規則2-1=曾接受過至少3個療程（每3週一療程，至少7週）的非taxane化學治療":
  // 計算符合條件的代表療程數；每個起始日只保留結束日最晚的一筆
  Count(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder1
      where MROrder1.intent = 'order'
        and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder1, CodeConcept."非taxane化學治療")
        and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
        and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
        and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder1)
        // 若同一起始日有多筆藥物，只保留結束日最晚者作為該療程代表
        and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
        ) =
          Max(
            [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse1
              where MRSameCourse1.intent = 'order'
                and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse1, CodeConcept."非taxane化學治療")
                and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
                and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
                and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse1)
                and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                )
              return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
              )
          )
  ) >= 3
  // 只累加代表療程的天數，避免同一療程內多筆藥物重複計算
  and Sum(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder2
      where MROrder2.intent = 'order'
        and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder2, CodeConcept."非taxane化學治療")
        and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
        and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
        and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder2)
        // 若同一起始日有多筆藥物，只保留結束日最晚者作為該療程代表
        and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
        ) =
          Max(
            [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse2
              where MRSameCourse2.intent = 'order'
                and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse2, CodeConcept."非taxane化學治療")
                and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
                and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
                and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse2)
                and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                )
              return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
              )
          )
      return all
        difference in days between
          FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
          )
          and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
          )
  ) >= 49


//1規則2-2:3個療程(9週)的taxane藥物
define "1規則2-2=3個療程(9週)的taxane藥物":
  // 計算符合條件的代表療程數；每個起始日只保留結束日最晚的一筆
  Count(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder1
      where MROrder1.intent = 'order'
        and (Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder1, CodeConcept.L01CD01)
          or Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder1, CodeConcept.L01CD02))
        and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
        and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
        and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder1)
        // 若同一起始日有多筆藥物，只保留結束日最晚者作為該療程代表
        and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
        ) =
          Max(
            [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse1
              where MRSameCourse1.intent = 'order'
                and (Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse1, CodeConcept.L01CD01)
          or Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse1, CodeConcept.L01CD02))
                and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
                and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
                and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse1)
                and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                )
              return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
              )
          )
  ) >= 3
  // 只累加代表療程的天數，避免同一療程內多筆藥物重複計算
  and Sum(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder2
      where MROrder2.intent = 'order'
        and (Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder2, CodeConcept.L01CD01)
          or Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder2, CodeConcept.L01CD02))
        and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
        and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
        and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder2)
        // 若同一起始日有多筆藥物，只保留結束日最晚者作為該療程代表
        and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
        ) =
          Max(
            [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse2
              where MRSameCourse2.intent = 'order'
                and (Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse2, CodeConcept.L01CD01)
          or Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse2, CodeConcept.L01CD02))
                and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
                and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
                and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse2)
                and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                  (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
                )
              return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
                (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
              )
          )
      return all
        difference in days between
          FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
          )
          and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
          )
  ) >= 63


define "1規則2=曾接受過至少6個療程的化學治療":
"1規則2-1=曾接受過至少3個療程（每3週一療程，至少7週）的非taxane化學治療"
and "1規則2-2=3個療程(9週)的taxane藥物"


//1規則3:至少3個療程(9週)的trastuzumab術前輔助治療，仍有殘留病灶的術後輔助治療
define "手術日期(opdate)":
  Max(
    flatten(
      [Claim] C
        return (
          C.procedure Proc
            where Proc.date is not null
            return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(Proc.date)
        )
    )
  )

define "病摘敘明trastuzumab術前輔助治療後仍有殘留病灶":
    exists (
        [Claim] C
        where exists (
            C.diagnosis D
            where exists (
                D.type.text T
                where Matches(T.value, '(?i).*(trastuzumab術前輔助治療後仍有殘留病灶).*')
            )
        )
    )

define "至少3個療程(9週)的trastuzumab術前輔助治療，仍有殘留病灶的術後輔助治療":
  Count(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder1
    where MROrder1.intent = 'order'
      and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder1, CodeConcept.L01FD01)
      and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
      and MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
      and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder1)
      and "手術日期(opdate)" > FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
        (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
      )
      and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
        (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
      ) =
        Max(
          [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse1
          where MRSameCourse1.intent = 'order'
            and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse1, CodeConcept.L01FD01)
            and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
            and MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
            and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse1)
            and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
              (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
            ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
              (MROrder1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
            )
          return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MRSameCourse1.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
          )
        )
  ) >= 3
  and Sum(
    [MedicationRequest] MROrder2
    where MROrder2.intent = 'order'
      and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MROrder2, CodeConcept.L01FD01)
      and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
      and MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
      and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MROrder2)
      and "手術日期(opdate)" > FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
        (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
      )
      and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
        (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
      ) =
        Max(
          [MedicationRequest] MRSameCourse2
          where MRSameCourse2.intent = 'order'
            and Reusable."HasMedicationCode"(MRSameCourse2, CodeConcept.L01FD01)
            and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.period = 3
            and MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.periodUnit.value = 'wk'
            and Reusable."HasValidTiming"(MRSameCourse2)
            and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
              (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
            ) = FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
              (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
            )
          return FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
            (MRSameCourse2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
          )
        )
    return all
      difference in days between
        FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).start
        )
        and FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(
          (MROrder2.dosageInstruction[0].timing.repeat.bounds as Period).end
        )
  ) >= 63

define "1規則3=至少3個療程(9週)的trastuzumab術前輔助治療，仍有殘留病灶的術後輔助治療":
"病摘敘明trastuzumab術前輔助治療後仍有殘留病灶"
and "至少3個療程(9週)的trastuzumab術前輔助治療，仍有殘留病灶的術後輔助治療"
and "本次申請紀錄" is not null
and Reusable."醫令類別為1"


//條件4:需符合下列任一條件
//I.具腋下淋巴結轉移但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人。
//Ⅱ.未發生腋下淋巴結轉移，但雌激素受體(ER)為陰性且腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人。

//1規則4-1:具腋下淋巴結轉移但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人
define "ICD代碼檢核_布林值": Reusable."ICD-10使用C50"

define "醫令類別為1_布林值":Reusable."醫令類別為1"

//1規則4-1-1:具腋下淋巴結轉移
define "1規則4-1-1=具腋下淋巴結轉移":
  exists (
    [Observation] O
      where exists (
        O.code.coding Cdg
          where Cdg.code = '399390009'
            and Cdg in CodeConcept.SNOMED
      )
        and O.value is not null
        and O.value is FHIR.string
        and Matches((O.value as FHIR.string).value, '.*N[1-9].*')
  )

//1規則4-1-2:但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人
define "1規則4-1-2=癌症分期分數或結果為M=0":
  Reusable."癌症分期分數或結果為M=0"

define "1規則4-1-2=3個月內影像報告":
Reusable."HasRecentImageReport"("本次申請起始日期", 90)


define "1規則4-1-2=3個月內有檢查報告":
Reusable."HasRecentMolecularReport"("本次申請起始日期", 90)

define "1規則4-1-2=但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人":
  Reusable."ICD-10使用C50"
  and "1規則4-1-2=癌症分期分數或結果為M=0"
  and "1規則4-1-2=3個月內影像報告"
  or "1規則4-1-2=3個月內有檢查報告"
  


define "1規則4-1=具腋下淋巴結轉移但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人":
  "1規則4-1-1=具腋下淋巴結轉移"
    and not "1規則4-1-2=但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人"


//1規則4-2:未發生腋下淋巴結轉移，但雌激素受體(ER)為陰性且腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人
//1規則4-2-1:未發生腋下淋巴結轉移
define "1規則4-2-1=未發生腋下淋巴結轉移":
  Count(
    [Observation] O
    where exists (
    O.code.coding Cdg
    where Cdg.code = '399390009'
    and Cdg in CodeConcept.SNOMED
    )
    and O.value is not null
    and O.value is FHIR.string
    and Matches((O.value as FHIR.string).value, '.*N[0].*')
  ) > 0

////1規則4-2-2:雌激素受體(ER)為陰性
define "1規則4-2-2=檢驗檢查-ER陰性":
  Reusable."HasTestObservationResult"(CodeConcept.MolecularER, { 'NEG' }, '(?i).*(陰性|negative).*')

define "1規則4-2-2=基因檢測-ER陰性":
  Reusable."HasGeneInfoComponentResult"(CodeConcept.MolecularER, { 'NEG' }, '(?i).*(陰性|negative).*')

define "檢查報告-1規則4-2-2=E雌激素受體(ER)為陰性":
  Reusable."HasDiagnosticReportResult"(CodeConcept.MolecularER, '(?i).*(陰性|negative).*')

define "1規則4-2-2=E雌激素受體(ER)為陰性":
  "1規則4-2-2=檢驗檢查-ER陰性" or "1規則4-2-2=基因檢測-ER陰性"
  or "檢查報告-1規則4-2-2=E雌激素受體(ER)為陰性"


////1規則4-2-3:病摘敘明腫瘤大於2公分
define "1規則4-2-3=病摘敘明腫瘤大於2公分":
    exists (
        [Claim] C
        where exists (
            C.diagnosis D
            where exists (
                D.type.text T
                where Matches(T.value, '(?i).*(腫瘤大於2公分).*')
            )
        )
    )

define "1規則4-2-3=腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人":
  Reusable."ICD-10使用C50"
  and "1規則4-2-3=病摘敘明腫瘤大於2公分"
  and "1規則4-1-2=3個月內影像報告"

define "1規則4-2＝未發生腋下淋巴結轉移，但雌激素受體(ER)為陰性且腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人":
"1規則4-2-1=未發生腋下淋巴結轉移" 
and "1規則4-2-2=E雌激素受體(ER)為陰性"
and "1規則4-2-3=腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人"

define "1規則4=需符合下列任一條件":
  "1規則4-1=具腋下淋巴結轉移但無遠處臟器轉移之早期乳癌病人"
  or "1規則4-2＝未發生腋下淋巴結轉移，但雌激素受體(ER)為陰性且腫瘤大於2公分之早期乳癌病人"
//主要規定一
define "主要規定一":
"1規則1=使用於具HER2過度表現(IHC 3+或FISH+)之早期乳癌病人"
and "1規則2=曾接受過至少6個療程的化學治療"
//and "1規則3=至少3個療程(9週)的trastuzumab術前輔助治療，仍有殘留病灶的術後輔助治療"
and "1規則4=需符合下列任一條件"

//============================================
// 主要規定二：續用條件－治療持續給付
//============================================

//條件1:核准後每24週須檢附療效評估資料再次申請，若疾病有惡化情形即不應再行申請

// 本次申請紀錄（以最新一筆申請作為本次申請）
define "本次申請紀錄":
  Reusable."LatestMedicationPlan"(CodeConcept.L01FD03)

define "本次申請起始日期":
  Reusable."GetStartTime"("本次申請紀錄")

// 前次申請紀錄（本次申請之前最近一次的申請）
define "前次申請紀錄":
  Reusable."LatestMedicationPlanBefore"(CodeConcept.L01FD03, "本次申請起始日期")

// 檢查本次申請療程長度是否在24週內
define "2規則1-1=每24週須再次申請並檢附療效評估資料":
  Reusable."醫令類別為1" 
  and Reusable."續用註記為2"
  and "本次申請紀錄" is not null
  and Reusable."HasMedicationPlanPeriodWithinDays"(CodeConcept.L01FD03, 168)


//條件2:疾病有惡化情形須停止使用

// 取得前次治療紀錄（最近一次已完成的治療）
define "前次治療紀錄":
